name: Haregaku!
source:
Aoi is a practice teacher. One day, he receives a letter from Himawari, one of his students. He goes to the roof of the school building as the letter asked, but there is Aika, his lifelong friend. When he is confused, she suddenly presses herself against him.... What's going on...?

[From ErogeShop]
